item.title: Rhode Island Hospitality Education Foundation’s ProStart Culinary Competition
item.description: Warwick Area Career and Technical Center won the Culinary Arts competition, and as part of their prize, their dish will be featured as an appetizer at the Boat House in Tiverton. First Place for Hospitality Management went to CHARIHOTech.
